mutants.category: AMS Telemetry / Ingress Shift Zero Detection
mutants.description: Analog-mixed signal telemetry and serial ingress shift zero detection corruption: OP_SHIFTIN in MSB mode checks gpio_in[pin_idx] instead of !gpio_in[pin_idx] for zero flag assertion, causing null samples (all zeros) to deassert z and non-zero samples with MSBs=0 to falsely assert z, corrupting delta-sigma bitstream null-detection and packet delimiting
